The '''Hoverdale bandits''' were a group of bandits on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] led by the conman [[Andro Hoverdale]]. Their base of operations was a [[Hoverdale's Hideout|cave]] in the Tatooinian [[Desert/Legends|desert]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] working for the [[Azure Cabal]] was sent by [[Propti Xaroon]] to search and retrieve her belongings that had been stolen by Hoverdale [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier. The mercenary entered the bandits' cave and killed several of the bandits before one of them revealed where Xaroon's belongings could be found.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
But before the mercenary could take Xaroon's pouch, Hoverdale discovered the intruder and attacked. A fight ensued in which Hoverdale was killed.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Hoverdale bandits were a criminal group in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. They were added to the game with [http://starwarsgalaxies.station.sony.com/players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007 Chapter 6: ''Dangers of the Wild''] in May 2007.

During a quest for the NPC Propti Xaroon, the player had to enter their cave and kill bandits until a clue to the location of Xaroon's pouch was found. If the player took too long to get the pouch after getting the clue, Hoverdale sent the player a warning. A short time after this warning, Hoverdale appeared near the player and attacked. If the player was quick, it was possible to complete the quest without having to fight and kill Hoverdale.
